mapper.insert: insert into ai_workbook (name, doc_type, content, user_id, create_by, create_time) values ( #{name}, #{type}, #{content}, #{userId}, #{createBy}, now() )
mapper.update: update ai_workbook set name = #{name}, doc_type = #{type}, content = #{content}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where workbook_id = #{workbookId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select workbook_id, name, doc_type, user_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from ai_workbook where user_id = #{userId} order by update_time desc, workbook_id desc
